responsibility: This autogenerated option-metadata file maps GNU Fortran command-line options declared in `lang.opt` to documentation URL suffixes in the GCC and gfortran manuals. It is part of GCC’s generated option/help infrastructure rather than semantic compilation logic: for each option spelling it records the manual anchor to use for generic GCC docs and, where applicable, the Fortran-specific anchor (`LangUrlSuffix_Fortran`), allowing diagnostic, help, or tooling code that knows an option name to attach stable links to the correct user documentation page.
